argv: import os,json,shutil,subprocess; shutil.copyfile('/bin/true','/tmp/probe'); os.chmod('/tmp/probe',0o755); m=[l.strip() for l in open('/proc/self/mountinfo') if l.split()[4]=='/tmp']; r={'mounts':m,'exec_exit':subprocess.run(['/tmp/probe']).returncode}; print(json.dumps(r)); assert len(m)==1 and 'noexec' not in m[0].split()[5].split(',') and r['exec_exit']==0
